entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Devtoberfest signups analytics report
entries.summary: A new analytical report in the admin dashboard shows Devtoberfest signup trends by day and geography, giving content managers instant visibility into registration activity.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Admin editor: long-form fields now use a proper text area
entries.summary: Long text fields such as descriptions and markdown content in the admin content editor now render as a properly-sized textarea, making it much more comfortable to write and review multi-paragraph content.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: No more red error highlighting on unrecognised code tokens
entries.summary: Code blocks no longer show distracting red Chroma error styling on tokens the syntax highlighter could not parse — those tokens now render as plain text instead of looking like errors.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Clearer quiz badge and current-step indicator
entries.summary: The quiz completion badge is now easier to spot, and your current tutorial step is highlighted with a ring and a subtle pulse animation so you can always see where you are at a glance.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Devtoberfest session times now shown in your local timezone only
entries.summary: Devtoberfest sessions and activity times now display exclusively in your local timezone, removing the confusing dual-timezone display that showed UTC alongside local time.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Author guide: Mission and Group content model explained
entries.summary: Updated author documentation now clarifies how missions map to groups in the new platform and explains how to structure multi-step learning paths as groups — essential reading for contributors building tutorial series.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Multi-select quiz answers now validate correctly
entries.summary: Quiz questions that require selecting multiple correct answers (checkboxes) now validate correctly, so tutorials using multi-select questions work as expected instead of falsely rejecting valid answers.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Devtoberfest live session recordings show YouTube thumbnails
entries.summary: Recorded Devtoberfest live-stream sessions now display their YouTube thumbnail previews on the sessions page instead of showing a blank placeholder image.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: AEM-legacy multi-paragraph notes render as a single callout
entries.summary: Tutorial notes and callouts that were originally authored across multiple paragraphs in the old AEM system now render as a single properly-formatted block instead of splitting into bare disconnected text fragments.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Joule button works in embedded reader mode
entries.summary: The Joule AI assistant button in the read-only embedded tutorial view now correctly opens the Joule panel when clicked, instead of silently doing nothing.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: SAP CodeJam events appear in the homepage events band
entries.summary: Upcoming SAP CodeJam events now appear in the homepage events section alongside other community events, so visitors can discover in-person learning opportunities without having to navigate to a separate page.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Gamification badge delivery resumes after credential fix
entries.summary: Badge and point awards to the NGDS gamification system resume reliably after fixing how the platform reads authentication credentials from the destination service — completions that were queued will now flush through.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Docs: SAP Discovery Center .model.json integration
entries.summary: Developer documentation now covers the `.model.json` endpoint that feeds SAP Discovery Center mission cards, clarifying the contract between the developer portal and the Discovery Center catalog.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: NGDS OAuth2 token flow fixed for badge delivery
entries.summary: Badge and point awards to the SAP gamification system now complete successfully by working around a BTP restriction on credential-in-body OAuth2 token requests that was silently blocking all deliveries.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Adopt DEV/main release branching strategy
entries.summary: The repository now uses a two-branch model — DEV for integration and main for production releases — giving the team a stable production branch and a safe surface for integrating new work before it ships.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Devtoberfest contest window: countdown timer with exact times and timezone
entries.summary: The Devtoberfest contest period now shows a live countdown timer with the exact start and end times in your local timezone, plus a tooltip explaining the contest window rules so you know precisely when your submissions count.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Homepage link-health overrides apply correctly at build time
entries.summary: Link health overrides set by content authors in the admin interface are now correctly applied when the page is built, preventing valid links from being incorrectly flagged as broken in the homepage navigation.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Embedded tutorials now have step navigation, Joule, and Next controls
entries.summary: Tutorials embedded in third-party apps now include a persistent action bar with step navigation, Joule AI assistant access, and a Next button, making the embedded reading experience as interactive as the full developer portal.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: New operational alerts for pipeline errors, secrets, broken links, and stuck publishes
entries.summary: Automated alerts now fire when the content rebuild pipeline encounters errors, secrets approach expiry, broken links are detected, or a content publish gets stuck — reducing time-to-detection for platform issues.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Devtoberfest: iCal and RSS calendar feeds plus add-to-calendar links
entries.summary: You can now subscribe to the full Devtoberfest session schedule via iCal or RSS, and add individual sessions to your calendar with a single click — making it easy to plan which sessions to attend from your existing calendar app.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Security dependency updates (undici, sharp, tar)
entries.summary: Production dependencies undici, sharp, and tar have been updated to versions that address Dependabot-flagged security advisories.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Tutorial pages no longer flash unstyled components before load
entries.summary: Tutorial pages no longer briefly flicker with unstyled UI5 browser components before the UI framework finishes initialising — content is now hidden until it is ready, removing the visual flash on page load.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Tutorial breadcrumb step-picker respects authored sequence order
entries.summary: The breadcrumb dropdown that lets you jump between tutorial steps now lists them in their correct authored sequence rather than alphabetically, so the picker matches the actual reading order of a mission or group.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: QA channel navigator: search and filter only (no homepage sections)
entries.summary: The tutorial navigator on the QA content preview channel now shows only the search and filter interface, dropping the promotional homepage sections that were inappropriate for a content review environment.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Event-display kiosk WebSocket no longer requires login
entries.summary: The live event display screen used at SAP community events can now establish its real-time WebSocket connection without requiring an authenticated session, fixing the connection errors that were disconnecting kiosk displays.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Joule help button no longer overlaps the Next navigation button
entries.summary: The Joule AI help floating button no longer covers the Next navigation button when reading tutorials in a group, so both controls are independently accessible without one obscuring the other.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Hotfix content rebuilds now ship correct versioned JS paths
entries.summary: Single-tutorial hotfix rebuilds now correctly embed the fingerprinted (cache-busted) JavaScript island paths in the published HTML, preventing visitors from receiving stale JS bundles after a quick content update.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: First-time visitors are no longer auto-redirected to login
entries.summary: The portal no longer automatically triggers a login redirect for first-time visitors — only returning users who previously authenticated are silently re-signed in, giving new readers a frictionless anonymous experience.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Admin change history restored for content records
entries.summary: Edit history logging in the admin interface is working again — changes to tutorials, missions, and configuration now correctly appear in the Change History panel as expected.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Tutorial step-timing statistics now persist correctly on HANA
entries.summary: A database compatibility issue that caused tutorial reading-time statistics to fail silently on HANA (while appearing to work locally) has been resolved by switching to the correct SAP CAP query API.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Admin shelf and verb-definition reports load data automatically
entries.summary: The homepage shelf configuration and verb definitions list pages in the admin interface now load their data automatically when opened, rather than requiring a manual refresh click.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Empty admin notification popup no longer shows blank space
entries.summary: The admin notification popup now displays a clean empty state when there are no pending alerts, instead of showing an awkward layout gap.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: AEM-legacy blockquoted code samples render inside their code window
entries.summary: Code samples in tutorials originally authored in AEM that were wrapped in blockquotes now render correctly inside the code window instead of appearing as raw text outside it.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Content publish: rejected reverts shown correctly, not as failures
entries.summary: When a content publish intentionally rejects a rollback attempt via the no-revert guard, the outcome is now correctly reported as 'Rejected' rather than misleadingly displayed as 'Verify FAILED'.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Tutorial contributor name no longer shows as 'Unknown'
entries.summary: Tutorial overview pages now correctly display the contributor's display name instead of 'Unknown' for authors whose profile is linked to an SAP Community account.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Next/Previous navigation stays within the current group or mission
entries.summary: When reading a tutorial that is part of a group or mission, the Next and Previous buttons now stay within that group's sequence instead of jumping to unrelated tutorials from outside the learning path.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: New alerts for NGDS gamification backlog and exhausted retries
entries.summary: Operators now receive automated alerts when the badge and point delivery backlog to the gamification system is growing, or when all retry attempts have been exhausted — enabling faster incident response before developers notice missing rewards.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Badge delivery failures are now visible in metrics and alerts
entries.summary: Badge and point award failures are now accurately reflected in platform metrics and trigger operational alerts, replacing the previous silent failure mode that made NGDS delivery issues invisible to the team.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Homepage content edits now automatically trigger a rebuild
entries.summary: Editing homepage shelves, featured topics, or other catalog content in the admin interface now automatically triggers a content rebuild, so changes reach visitors without needing a separate manual rebuild step.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: QA tutorial navigator now accessible at its own URL
entries.summary: The QA preview version of the tutorial navigator is now correctly served at its own path, allowing content reviewers to access it independently from the main navigator.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Admin UI edits and deletes now work through the Akamai edge
entries.summary: Admin panel content updates and deletions now work correctly in production — PATCH and DELETE requests are tunnelled through OData batch to bypass Akamai's 501 rejection of those HTTP methods.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Live event display WebSocket connection fixed
entries.summary: The real-time event display used at SAP community events can now establish its WebSocket connection correctly after WebSocket support was explicitly enabled in the app router configuration.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Blue-green deployments verify asset links before production swap
entries.summary: Blue-green production deployments now run a pre-swap check that confirms all CSS and JavaScript assets referenced in HANA-served pages resolve on the new instance before traffic is switched over, catching broken asset references before users see them.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Developer Advocate photos update immediately after upload
entries.summary: Developer Advocate profile photos now appear immediately after uploading a new image — the CDN cache is invalidated on save so the updated photo is visible right away instead of being stuck behind a stale cached version.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Devtoberfest Sessions page no longer blanks on invalid timezone data
entries.summary: The Devtoberfest Sessions page now fails gracefully if a session has an unrecognised timezone value, rendering the remaining sessions normally instead of going completely blank.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: SAP Discovery Center mission cards restored
entries.summary: The `.model.json` endpoint that SAP Discovery Center uses to display developer portal missions has been reinstated, restoring the integration that was broken during the migration away from the legacy AEM platform.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: CSS and JS assets no longer 404 after a fingerprinted deployment
entries.summary: JavaScript and CSS bundles from the previous deployment are now retained during new releases, preventing the brief window where visitors with cached HTML could request a versioned asset that no longer existed on the server.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: QA channel quiz questions fully rendered (dependency fix)
entries.summary: A missing dependency installation step in the QA content rebuild pipeline has been added, fully resolving the issue where quiz questions and interactive validation steps were not displayed on QA preview pages.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Quiz questions now render on the QA preview channel
entries.summary: Tutorial quiz questions and interactive step validation now display correctly on the QA content preview channel after the JavaScript island manifest was added to the QA build process.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: User account auto-provisioning works reliably on HANA
entries.summary: Automatic user account creation when a visitor links their SAP Community profile now works correctly in the HANA-backed production environment, fixing a silent insert failure that left users unable to have their progress tracked.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Admin-editable configuration no longer overwritten on deployment
entries.summary: Configuration values that admins edit at runtime — homepage shelves, featured topics — are no longer overwritten by seed data during deployment, preventing live edits from being silently wiped on every new release.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Tutorial right rail restored after CDS code block layout regression
entries.summary: An unbalanced HTML tag in the CDS syntax highlighter was pushing the tutorial progress sidebar off-screen; the fix restores correct side-by-side layout so the right rail displays normally alongside CDS code samples.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Browse, Topics, and other content pages now served from HANA
entries.summary: The Browse, Topics, Verbs, Sitemap, and other non-tutorial content pages are now served dynamically from the CAP/HANA content store, completing the migration away from static Hugo files and enabling live content updates without a full redeploy.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Per-tutorial override for the content publish no-revert guard
entries.summary: Content operators can now override the no-revert publish guard on a per-tutorial basis when a genuine rollback is needed, avoiding the all-or-nothing configuration change that was previously required.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: CDS syntax highlighting colours restored in tutorial code blocks
entries.summary: SAP Core Data Services (CDS) code blocks in tutorials now show correct syntax highlighting colours after a CSS mapping regression was identified and fixed.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Content pages can now be served from HANA (initial rollout)
entries.summary: The infrastructure for serving non-tutorial content pages from the HANA content store is now in place, initially rolled out dark to enable incremental validation before the full cut-over to dynamic page serving.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Puzzle progress survives login, and orphaned drafts are recovered
entries.summary: Progress made on coding puzzles before signing in is now correctly merged with your account when you log in, completed puzzles are properly recognised after a browser refresh, and orphaned draft submissions are automatically recovered.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Repository licensed under Apache-2.0 (OSPO compliance)
entries.summary: The developer portal codebase is now explicitly licensed under Apache-2.0 with REUSE-compliant headers, meeting SAP open-source compliance requirements as the repository moves toward public visibility.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: CDS code highlighting restored on HANA-published tutorials
entries.summary: CDS syntax highlighting was missing from published tutorials served from HANA after a build pipeline regression; the Shiki highlighter is now correctly invoked during the HANA publish step.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Link-health checker no longer flags internal or auth-gated URLs as broken
entries.summary: The homepage link-health checker no longer incorrectly marks internal portal URLs and login-protected pages as broken — those links are now either skipped or probed with the correct authentication context.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Versioned JS and CSS bundles are retained across deployments
entries.summary: Content-hashed JavaScript and CSS assets are now preserved when a new version is deployed, eliminating the brief window where visitors with cached HTML pages could request a bundle that no longer existed on the server.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Navigator mission cards link correctly for nested-group missions
entries.summary: Mission cards in the tutorial navigator now link correctly when the mission's tutorials are structured as nested groups, fixing cards that previously led to a dead end.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Homepage footer cleaned up: broken links and padlock icon hidden
entries.summary: Broken placeholder links in the homepage directory footer and a stray sign-in padlock icon have been hidden, cleaning up footer content that was inadvertently visible since launch.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Mobile navigation menu now opens on tap
entries.summary: On mobile devices, tapping the Navigate button in the site header now correctly opens the navigation popover instead of doing nothing.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Admin portal no longer reload-loops on authorization errors
entries.summary: The admin portal no longer enters an infinite reload loop when a session lacks the required authorization scope — it now shows a clear access-denied message so the user knows what action to take.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: App router recovers from transient module load errors on refresh
entries.summary: The application router now retries its module-loading step when a transient import error occurs, preventing a page refresh from leaving the site in a broken state after a brief network hiccup during startup.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Devtoberfest App Space missions load correctly
entries.summary: The Devtoberfest App Space now correctly resolves which mission is associated with an event, fixing a lookup direction bug that was preventing mission content from loading on the App Space page.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Animated GIFs in tutorials now animate correctly
entries.summary: Animated GIFs embedded in tutorial content now play their animations correctly — they are no longer flattened to static images by the CDN image processor.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Images and links inside Prerequisites tables now render correctly
entries.summary: Images and hyperlinks placed inside Prerequisites tables in tutorial content now render as expected instead of showing raw markdown syntax or escaped HTML tags.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Intermittent blank page on load fixed (bootstrap race condition)
entries.summary: A timing race between the app router's legacy redirect module and its initial page load was causing intermittent blank pages or redirect loops for some visitors — the startup sequence is now deterministic.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: GitHub Actions content rebuilds ship correct versioned JS paths
entries.summary: Single-tutorial hotfix rebuilds triggered via GitHub Actions now include the island manifest generation step, ensuring published HTML references versioned JS bundles rather than bare unversioned paths that would serve stale code.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: SAP events display on the correct calendar day
entries.summary: SAP events on the homepage now show on the calendar day they actually occur, rather than being shifted by server-side timezone conversion — community events authored in a non-UTC timezone no longer appear on the wrong date.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Hotfix rebuilds blocked when current CSS fingerprints are not yet deployed
entries.summary: A safety guard now prevents single-tutorial hotfix rebuilds from going through if the current build's CSS fingerprints have not been deployed yet, avoiding a state where published tutorial HTML references styles that do not exist on the server.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Cache invalidations now propagate across all server instances
entries.summary: Content cache and navigator cache invalidations now propagate reliably across all running server instances, preventing visitors from seeing stale content on one instance after a content publish updated another.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Community event dates now show the locally authored day
entries.summary: Community events such as CodeJams and workshops now display the date as authored, rather than being shifted by server timezone conversion — events authored as starting on a Monday no longer appear as Sunday in the portal.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: SAP Community profile linking now accepts a pasted profile URL
entries.summary: Linking your SAP Community profile to your developer account now works when you paste the full profile URL, and automatically creates your account record if it does not yet exist.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Raw image attributes no longer appear as text in option-tab blocks
entries.summary: Images inside option-tab blocks in tutorials no longer leak their raw HTML attributes as visible text below the image — the rendered output is now clean.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Local builds now reliably generate the JavaScript island manifest
entries.summary: The JavaScript island manifest — which maps Vue component names to their versioned filenames — is now explicitly generated as part of the main build step, fixing a long-standing issue where local builds shipped unversioned JS paths that would not match what was actually on the server.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Concepts page no longer 404s on hard refresh with a query string
entries.summary: Refreshing or directly navigating to a `/concepts/` URL with a query parameter no longer returns a 404 — the route is now correctly handled server-side.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Joule and SAP Fundamental Styles CSS are now cache-busted on update
entries.summary: The Joule AI assistant stylesheet and the SAP Fundamental Styles base CSS are now content-hashed, preventing browsers and CDN edges from serving stale cached versions of these critical stylesheets after a platform update.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Topics page concept links now point to published content
entries.summary: Placeholder concept links on the Topics page now point to real published concept pages instead of broken placeholder slugs, so all concept browsing links reach actual content.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Vue island JS bundles are now versioned to prevent stale code
entries.summary: Vue island JavaScript bundles are now content-hashed so CDN edges and browsers always fetch the current version after a deployment, eliminating the stale-JS problem that could leave interactive page elements in a broken state.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Developer Advocate profile card flip works correctly on iOS Safari
entries.summary: Developer Advocate profile cards now flip correctly on iOS Safari — the front photo is properly hidden when the card flips to reveal the back, instead of both sides being visible at the same time.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Homepage verb tiles always navigate on click, even after hovering
entries.summary: Clicking a learning verb tile on the homepage now reliably navigates to the correct page even after hovering over the card triggered the flip animation — the click target was previously lost after the animation completed.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Remaining page-level Hugo CSS files are now cache-busted
entries.summary: The remaining page-level stylesheets not yet covered by content hashing are now versioned, completing full CDN cache-busting coverage for CSS across the platform.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Devtoberfest event registrations can now be saved to the database
entries.summary: Devtoberfest event registrations can now be correctly persisted — a missing database sequence for generating registration IDs was causing all registrations to fail silently.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Hugo CSS files are content-hashed to prevent stale style delivery
entries.summary: Hugo-managed CSS files are now content-hashed at build time, ensuring CDN edges and browsers always retrieve the latest stylesheets after a new release rather than serving stale cached versions.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Navigator Type and Experience filter lists render fully
entries.summary: The Type and Experience filter panels in the tutorial navigator now render all available options instead of being cut off partway through the list.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Duplicate product tags in navigator filters are now merged
entries.summary: Duplicate Software Product tags in the tutorial navigator filter — caused by slight label variations across tutorial metadata — are now merged by display label, resulting in cleaner filter lists without repetitions.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Option-tab controls in tutorials render as interactive buttons
entries.summary: Option-tab controls in tutorials now render as interactive buttons as intended, rather than showing the raw HTML tag text that was being escaped by the Markdown renderer.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Explore page no longer breaks the Hugo build
entries.summary: A special character in the Explore page frontmatter description that was causing Hugo build failures has been escaped, restoring the ability to build the full site with the Explore page included.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Homepage learning verb tiles updated
entries.summary: The learning verb tiles on the homepage — the Browse by, Learn how to, and Discover action categories — have been updated with refreshed copy and links.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Tutorials can now be embedded in SAP Business AI Platform
entries.summary: Tutorials can now be rendered in a clean read-only mode inside SAP Business AI Platform (BAIP), with portal chrome hidden and only the tutorial content and step navigation exposed — enabling seamless in-context learning from within BAIP.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Production app router no longer crash-loops under load
entries.summary: The production app router was running out of memory under real traffic and crash-looping; its memory allocation has been increased to handle the load seen since the platform went live.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Devtoberfest Planner admin link resolves to the correct environment
entries.summary: The Devtoberfest Planner link in the admin interface now correctly resolves to the current environment — it was previously always pointing to DEV even when accessed from the PROD admin panel.

entries.label: Developer Portal
entries.title: Topics admin actions work reliably regardless of slug casing
entries.summary: Topic publish and unpublish actions in the admin interface now correctly normalise the topic slug before performing the lookup, fixing a case-sensitivity mismatch that was causing failures on any topic change.
